title: Norma metadata manifest, JSON form, version 1
description: Norma metadata manifest, schema version 1. Absent key = no opinion; null = clear the field. Schema validation alone is not sufficient: the loader also enforces integer literals for version, track, track_total, disc and disc_total (JSON Schema 2020-12 accepts 3.0 as an integer and 1.0 as equal to 1; MS11), refuses duplicate object keys, and checks real calendar dates, track <= track_total and disc <= disc_total, trimming and NFC, control characters, case-insensitive extra-name collisions and file selectors that normalise to a folder (metadata-schema MS2, MS7).

version.$comment: Must be the integer token 1; the loader refuses 1.0 (MS11).

fileKey.description: Selector: a path relative to the manifest's folder, '/' separators, '.' and '..' segments allowed; or a bare file name. Not '*', not absolute, not '~', no trailing '/', no NUL; the loader also refuses selectors that normalise to a folder ('.', '..'). A lexical matching key only, never opened (metadata-schema MS2, MS5, MS13).

text.description: Trimmed NFC text, 1-1000 characters; whitespace-only is refused.

extraName.description: Extra-name grammar (metadata-schema section 2.3). Canonical field names and 'file' have their own keys; reserved names are generated or removed by Norma. 'NORMA' is the processing-mark name (D-010, D-020, D-041).

date.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; calendar validity is checked by the loader.

artwork.description: Image path; relative paths resolve against the manifest's folder.
